thesis: Schools should teach shared standards and history without assessing conversion or membership.

ideas.statement: Science, intellectual history and religious/ethical study have distinct goals that can communicate; reform should improve evidence skills, not count converts.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Curriculum analysis must define country/year/track, distinguish official texts from teaching and use independent coding; proposed evaluation is not a completed school study.
